text: {"lessons":["I will not sell a holding solely because it is below my average cost; I will reassess its outlook and risk against the same criteria I use for every stock.","I will avoid frequent reversals and impulsive profit-taking: set a clear reason and plan for each trade, then review it when new information arrives.","A rising account value over a few periods does not show that my trading beats the market; I will track returns against a benchmark and keep position sizes and cash reserves appropriate to risk."]}
